summary: Extend the frozen connector-plugin runtime pillar with the provider-neutral Connector SDK v1 host/runtime/account boundary while keeping provider admission fail-closed until Tasks 025, 029 and 064.

impacts.evidence: Connector accounts remain organization/workspace scoped; the PostgreSQL account repository sets transaction-local tenant settings and migration 000012 retains forced RLS.
SDK health/error metadata is bounded to machine codes; raw provider response text is not durable account state, reducing accidental PII/credential persistence.
New manifest-v2/account/health/error contracts are additive. The older manifest schema is retained unchanged instead of being silently rewritten.
Task 010 changes no domain event type or EventBus envelope. Connector operation events remain owned by later capability/domain tasks.

SDK v1 now has executable family/capability validation, account/secret/runtime boundaries, normalized errors and a strict root Connector interface; provider admission remains disabled until 025/029/064.
Expand migration 000012 adds account version/health metadata and constraints without renaming provider or removing old-reader columns; all new columns have compatibility defaults.
Provider credentials remain opaque sec:v1 references; the SDK runtime exposes callback-only secret use, raw provider errors are discarded, and connector_accounts hard delete/truncate is blocked.
Task 010 defines capabilities but does not authorize sensitive writes; Tasks 017 and 029 remain mandatory approval/dry-run gates before mutating provider operations.
Stable connector/account identity and normalized machine reason codes provide safe audit identifiers; Task 010 deliberately avoids persisting raw remote bodies.
Stable account/manifest identity and normalized retry semantics establish inputs for later sync/reconciliation/conformance; Task 009 remains the consumer duplicate-effect boundary.
No webhook delivery or signing behavior is introduced by the root Connector SDK task.
Account health is normalized to unknown/healthy/degraded/unavailable with UTC check time and safe reason code; rate-limit/retry policy is explicit manifest metadata.
Migration 000012 is additive. Rollback disables Task-010 writers while preserving connector accounts, mappings and secret references; physical provider-column rename is deferred.

Tests cover manifest/family/capability drift, FX/SMS vocabulary, account/secret validation, safe errors, retry bounds, registry duplicates, scoped secret bridging, migration guards and JSON Schema fixtures.
